generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.-NOT APPLICABLE

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending bidder should furnish the certificate of registration issued by state/ central Govt
The Tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.
The Intending bidder are advised to visit the site of work and access the tender documents well in advance.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The tender processing fee will not be refunded
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.

The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Through ONLINE only With validity from the date of opening of the tender. The tender schedule will be issued to the applicants who make payment through ONLINE only. Tenders received without valid EMD through e- payment will be rejected. Under this section of qualifying criteria the tenderer should furnish capacity details / format.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in e-portal within 3 days of opening of technical Bid

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, KRS Division, Krishnarajasagara, during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events
Defect liability period is THREE YEARS from the date of completion of the entire work, after issuing of work completion certificate from CNNL.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.
The tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The application made by the firm / company shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney shall be submitted

Necessary certificates should be signed by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent competent authority and should be countersigned by the superior officer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer or equivalent competent authority.

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or on going under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the last five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicants financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers.
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before attending the pre- bid meeting and also before submitting the tenders.

Royalty Charges shall be recovered as per the prevailing rates by the Department of Mines and Geology & The Intending bidder should strictly follow the Department of Mines & Geology circular no. 11189-1121 Dated:26.02.2024.

The rates quoted by the contractor must be inclusive of all Taxes, etc., (including GST). The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor.
GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time in running bill
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL/ Karnataka Research station, if not by any NABL accredited labs before use in this work.

The work includes all lead and lift / delift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per relevant Indian standard codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the expiry of the defect liability period.

Building and other construction workers welfare cess The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill.This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate.
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.
Sub leasing /subcontracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Subleasing/subcontracting are liable for rejection.

The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard.

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand, as an alternative the use of manufactured sand (M-sand)confirming to relevant IS specifications may be allowed during the remodeling work

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge. All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue. The rates for the specification in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts.
The contractor should have capacity of deploying centralized batching plant along with The transit mixture during execution of concrete works for both structures and lining.
Successful Bidder should submit the PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement.
Successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of acceptance, failing which his tender will be cancelled as per terminiation clause in Bid document
Related to qualification condition No :2, Idle charges for men & machineries for non- progress period delayed due to any reasons will not be paid.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted.
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor.
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender.
Conditions as per bid document.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Replacement and reconditioning of Damaged Roller Assemblies, Rubber seals , electromagnetic brakes of 80 ft, 50ft and 60 ft (VC) Sluice Gates and erection of 100 kVA new TC at south gate for gate operation KRS Dam

itemList.description: Supply of new 300 mm dia. roller assemblies as per Drg. No. AMN/RA/NE/KRS/-03 (Rev. R2) and fixing the same to the gate in place of unserviceable rollers. The roller shall be of IS 1030 Gr.280-520 material, machined to drawing dimensions, complete with axle shaft (20Cr13 SS), side plates (IS 2062 E250A), M-Seals, O-rings, CSK screws and grease nipple, as per the approved drawing and applicable BIS standards. Includes removal of unserviceable old roller, cleaning of axle seating in gate girder, fitting and aligning new roller, and trial rotation check prior to testing and complete the work in all respects as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Reconditioning of exisiting rollers by replacement of Spherical Roller Bearing No 22218E SKF / FAG / NSK or equivalent internationally approved make OD 160 mm X ID 90 mm X Width 40 mm including supply, pressing in / pressing out with appropriate tools, check of bearing housing bore and shaft journal, cleaning of seating surfaces, application of approved anti-corrosion grease before fitment, and checking for free rotation after assembly; replacement of M-Seals (OD110 X ID90 X 12 mm, rubber), O-Rings (OD180 X ID170 X Dia 5 mm, rubber), CSK Screws (M12 X 25 mm, IS 1367) and Dia 6 Grease Nipple (IS 4009);reconditioning of existing axle shaft to suit the new bearing bore and bearing seating in the roller body; reconditioning of cover/side plates to suit oil-seal seating; cleaning, degreasing and protective coating of all machined surfaces; reassembly and installation running check , Includes all materials, labour, lifting tackles and scaffolding. (Applicable to serviceable rollers) complete in all respects as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Supply, fitting and testing of bulb-head rubber seals for vertical lift sluice gates including removal of existing worn, hardened and damaged seals; cleaning and preparation of seal carriers and seal seats; supply of new bulb-head rubber seal / Neoprene conforming to IS 4622 : 2003, hardness 60 +or- 5 Shore A, tensile strength minimum 12 MPa, elongation at break minimum 350%, compression set maximum 25% with PTFE Teflon-clad sealing face to reduce seal friction coefficient to 0.20 as recommended by DSRP; cutting, fitting and clamping of side seals and bottom seal to each gate with stainless steel clamping flat bars and SS 316 M16 bolts torqued to specified values; factory-vulcanised corner joints at bottom-to-side seal junctions; verification of uniform bulb contact with seal face along full length; functional gate operation test to confirm smooth travel without seal binding; and submission of material test certificates confirming compliance with IS 4622 - 2003 and IS 3400 series complete in all respects including all labour, materials, clamping hardware, fasteners, consumables, scaffolding and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Supply and fixing of cast iron counterweight blocks (approx. 300 kg per gate) conforming to IS 210 Grade FG 200 or higher on horizontal girders of vertical lift sluice gates, including removal of existing ballast, design verification, secure fixing, protective painting and load checks to ensure satisfactory self-closure performance within the safe capacity of the hoist system complete with all labour, materials, consumables, tools and tackles, testing and incidental works as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Complete.

Rectification and restoration of embedded parts of vertical lift sluice gate comprising roller tracks, groove liners, seal seat tracks (side, top and bottom), gate guide frames and guides, and sill beam assembly; including surface preparation by mechanical cleaning, wire brushing, power-tool grinding and rust converter treatment to Sa 2.5 / St 3 standard; build-up welding of worn and pitted roller track running surfaces using SS electrodes (E308L / E316L) with inter-pass grinding ; precision grinding and profile correction of roller running surface to flatness less than or equal to 0.5 mm/m; re-facing and re-grinding of SS groove liners and seal seat faces ; repair welding of cracked welds in guide frames, rib plates and sill beam; re-alignment of distorted guide frames; complete replacement of all damaged, corroded and missing fasteners (SS 316 / GI / MS) torqued to specified values; application of protective coating system one coat zinc-rich epoxy primer (40 micron DFT min.) and three coats coal tar epoxy paint (100 micron DFT per coat, total greater equal to 340micron) with DFT verification and holiday testing; post-rectification dimensional verification and submission of inspection records to Engineer-in-Charge; and conducting gate self-closure load check at Full Reservoir Level with submission of signed test certificate; complete with all labour, materials, machinery, scaffolding, testing, consumables, tools and tackles and incidental works as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. 80 ft level gate Vertical lift sluice gate embedded parts assembly KRS Dam (80 ft level). Clear vent opening: 3060 mm. Sill to top seal centre (F): 6200 mm. Roller track C/C: 3630 mm. Total embedded parts weight (from BOQ): 5110.73 kg. Roller track length (both sides): 2 X 6.2 m = 12.40 m. Total seal track perimeter: 18.52 m. Painting area @ 10 m²/tonne: 65 m².

Rectification and restoration of embedded parts of vertical lift sluice gate comprising roller tracks, groove liners, seal seat tracks (side, top and bottom), gate guide frames and guides, and sill beam assembly; including surface preparation by mechanical cleaning, wire brushing, power-tool grinding and rust converter treatment to Sa 2.5 / St 3 standard; build-up welding of worn and pitted roller track running surfaces using SS electrodes (E308L / E316L) with inter-pass grinding ; precision grinding and profile correction of roller running surface to flatness less than or equal to 0.5 mm/m; re-facing and re-grinding of SS groove liners and seal seat faces ; repair welding of cracked welds in guide frames, rib plates and sill beam; re-alignment of distorted guide frames; complete replacement of all damaged, corroded and missing fasteners (SS 316 / GI / MS) torqued to specified values; application of protective coating system one coat zinc-rich epoxy primer (40 micron DFT min.) and three coats coal tar epoxy paint (100 micron DFT per coat, total greater equal to 340micron) with DFT verification and holiday testing; post-rectification dimensional verification and submission of inspection records to Engineer-in-Charge; and conducting gate self-closure load check at Full Reservoir Level with submission of signed test certificate; complete with all labour, materials, machinery, scaffolding, testing, consumables, tools and tackles and incidental works as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Complete.50 ft level gate - Vertical lift sluice gate embedded parts assembly KRS Dam (+50 ft level). Clear vent opening: 1830 mm. Sill to top seal centre (F): 4660 mm. Roller track C/C: 2316 mm. Total embedded parts weight (from BOQ): 6907.87 kg. Roller track length (both sides): 2 X 24.38 m = 48.76 m. Total seal track perimeter: 12.98 m. Painting area @ 10 m²/tonne: 69 m².

Rectification and restoration of embedded parts of vertical lift sluice gate comprising roller tracks, groove liners, seal seat tracks (side, top and bottom), gate guide frames and guides, and sill beam assembly; including surface preparation by mechanical cleaning, wire brushing, power-tool grinding and rust converter treatment to Sa 2.5 / St 3 standard; build-up welding of worn and pitted roller track running surfaces using SS electrodes (E308L / E316L) with inter-pass grinding ; precision grinding and profile correction of roller running surface to flatness less than or equal to 0.5 mm/m; re-facing and re-grinding of SS groove liners and seal seat faces ; repair welding of cracked welds in guide frames, rib plates and sill beam; re-alignment of distorted guide frames; complete replacement of all damaged, corroded and missing fasteners (SS 316 / GI / MS) torqued to specified values; application of protective coating system one coat zinc-rich epoxy primer (40 micron DFT min.) and three coats coal tar epoxy paint (100 micron DFT per coat, total greater equal to 340micron) with DFT verification and holiday testing; post-rectification dimensional verification and submission of inspection records to Engineer-in-Charge; and conducting gate self-closure load check at Full Reservoir Level with submission of signed test certificate; complete with all labour, materials, machinery, scaffolding, testing, consumables, tools and tackles and incidental works as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Complete.-60 ft level gate - Vertical lift sluice gate embedded parts assembly KRS Dam (+60 ft level). Clear vent opening: 1830 mm. Sill to top seal centre (F): 3750 mm. Roller track C/C: 2320 mm. Roller track length-21.33m X 2 = 42.66 m. Total seal track perimeter: 10.98 . Painting area @ 10 m²/tonne: 62 m².

Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Electromagnetic Brakes for Rope Drum Hoists of Vertical Lift Sluice Gates including removal of existing worn-out brake assemblies; supply and installation of new fail-safe, spring-set and electrically released electromagnetic brakes of suitable capacity to hold the fully loaded gate and counterweight at any position without creep or drift; complete with electromagnet coil, armature, brake drum/disc, brake shoes/pads, springs, manual release mechanism, rectifier unit (where required) and all accessories conforming to relevant IS/BIS standards; suitable for 415 V, 3 Phase, 50 Hz supply and outdoor dam environment with minimum IP-55 protection and Class-F insulation; setting and adjustment of air gap, spring tension and braking torque; conducting insulation resistance tests, no-load and full-load operational trials, gate holding test and manual release test; submission of test certificates, drawings and O&M manuals; complete with all labour, materials, wiring, testing, commissioning and documentation as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Design, fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of fixed wheel type vertical lift emergency gate consisting of skin plate, horizontal and vertical girders, wheels, stiffeners, lifting brackets, guide rollers, ballast blocks, teflon claded rubber seals with all accessories for river sluice / canal sluice vent including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding, finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and three coats of cold applied coal tar epoxy paint, seal fixing and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.-80 ft and 60 ft level gate

Providing and engaging a certified commercial underwater diving team for inspecting the bell mouth region prior to lowering of bulkhead, Remove minor obstructions such as silt, debris, weeds, bamboo roots or accumulated deposits affecting seating, Guide controlled vertical lowering of temporary bulkhead gate from the upstream face and sealing of temporary steel bulkhead gates at the bell mouth on the upstream face of the dam, inspect for leakage between bulkhead and service gate region and facilitating dewatering operations and enabling detailed inspection of service gates and embedded parts, including subsequent removal and shifting of bulkhead gates after completion of inspection, inculding Air compressor with filtration unit and control panel , Full face mask / diving helmet with two-way communication system , Umbilical hose assembly (air supply + communication + lifeline) , Underwater lighting arrangements, Underwater HD videography and photography equipment , also including approved (10t) chain pulley blocks, wire ropes, D-shackles, lifting hooks and allied lifting accessories , hiring of Mobile Hydraulic Crane 50 t capacity for lifting, loading, transportation support, unloading, lowering, positioning and fixing of temporary steel bulkhead gate from storage yard to dam site and subsequent installation at gate bell mouth on upstream facecomplete in all respects as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing and fixing Steel work welded in built up sections/ framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer using structural steel etc. as required. In gratings, frames, guard bar, ladder, railings, brackets, gates and similar works including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in Charge.

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
